Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC with Redwood. We want Day 1 to be a tightly scoped, interactive lab so your engineering team can validate routing, prompt behavior, and an initial load-run. Proposed windows (PT):

- Option A: Tue Aug 18, 09:30–12:00 (PT) — focused on prompt review + routing rules
- Option B: Thu Aug 20, 13:00–16:30 (PT) — add a short load run at the end

Draft Day 1 agenda (attached: poc-prelim-agenda.pdf):
- 09:30 Quick intros & objectives (10m)
- 09:40 Prompt walkthrough and prompt-set alignment (30m)
- 10:10 Routing & model variant mapping (30m)
- 10:50 Break (10m)
- 11:00 Load-run planning + warmup and KV cache behavior (40m)
- 11:40 Short live run (20–30m) + observation
- 12:10 Next steps / owner assignments (20m)

Can you confirm preferred date and who from CloudBridge will join (names + roles)? Also please attach a short sample prompt set and your throughput targets so we can size the load-run appropriately. I’ve included a runbook template (runbook-template.docx) you can use to capture ops notes during the session.

If neither date works, suggest two alternatives and we’ll align.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Rachel

Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Day 1 recap — CloudBridge Immersive Lab (Aug 18) — notes and action items

Elena / Samir —

Recap from today’s lab (thanks to everyone who joined the morning session). Highlights:
- Completed prompt walkthrough and aligned on prompt normalization rules (we’ll apply simple sanitization for PII placeholders).
- Demonstrated routing policy: primary dedicated pool -> fallback to hosted variant when concurrency threshold reached. Failover latency observed ~120–180ms.
- Warmup and KV caching: 10-minute warmup performed; observed ~18% latency improvement for repeated prefixes.
- Short live run (30 minutes): reached 85 TPS at peak; we saw transient tail latency that we’ll investigate (likely related to batch sizing).

Action items (owners and proposed timelines):
- AI Ops (Samir): provide full sanitized prompt corpus + expected session-level labels by Aug 20. (Owner: Samir)
- Infra (Markus): tune batch sizing and produce a short experiment plan for tail-latency mitigation by Aug 22. (Owner: Markus)
- Solutions (Rachel): produce a Day 1 recap doc with screenshots, perf graphs, and a proposed Day 2 agenda (deliver by Aug 17 EOD). (Owner: Rachel)
- Docs (Monica): create shared Drive folder and drop the runbook + session artifacts; share link and edit permissions by Aug 16. (Owner: Monica)

Attachments: day1-recap.pdf (summary slides + perf graphs). I’ve also uploaded logs and the runbook to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCloudBridgePOC

Next session: propose Tue Aug 25, 09:30–12:00 (PT) to run tuned batches and a 1-hour extended load test. Please confirm availability.

Thanks — great collaboration today.

— Rachel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
